title: Regel Acht

hook.spoken: Nox brach Regel acht. Offiziell gibt es nur sieben.
hook.visual_question: Eine bloße Hand greift nach einem Siegel mit sieben leuchtenden Kerben und einem dunklen achten Schlitz.

character_decision: Nox berührt sein eigenes Echo trotz Miras Warnung.

micro_loop.question: Was ruft Nox hinter der versiegelten Tür?
micro_loop.resolution: Eine Taschenuhr — sein eigenes Echo, graviert mit N. VEYR · LINA.

macro_loop.question: Wer ist Lina, und warum vergisst Nox sie immer wieder?

twist: Es ist nicht das erste Mal: Nox hat Lina schon einmal vergessen.
cliffhanger: Auf der Rückseite des Fotos steht in Nox' eigener Handschrift: Lina lebt.

plants.what: Siegel: sieben leuchtende Kerben, ein dunkler achter Schlitz (ab Frame 0).
Gebrochener Goldring an Nox' linkem Kragen (S05, S07) = Signatur unter 'Lina lebt.' (S17).
Pip auf Nox' Schulter: die Nadel zeigt zur Tür (S05).
Vision: nicht gewählter Weg des Rückkehrtages (Nox fährt zurück, Lina wartet).
Lina hält in der Vision einen versiegelten Brief.
Hinter der Uhr: innere versiegelte Tür.

shots.fn: Hook: verbotene Grenze + unmögliche Regel (≤1,5 s)
shots.visual: ECU: Nox' bloße Hand greift nach dem Bronze-Siegel; sieben Kerben leuchten, die achte ist dunkel (Kerben als Grafik-Overlay, Bildmodelle zählen unzuverlässig).

kf.prompt: Extreme close-up macro shot of the young man from the reference image: only the edge of his face is visible at the top left, his bare pale right hand emerging from the navy blue sleeve of his coat reaches in from the left toward a large round bronze vault seal seen straight on, the whole seal is inside the frame on the right side; the seal has a smooth polished rim ring without any marks, slots or symbols and a small dark keyhole in its center; his fingertips stop a few centimeters before the metal and do not cover the seal; floating golden dust, dramatic warm rim light, dark background.

shots.visual: Die achte Kerbe flammt rot auf, rotes Warnlicht.
Totale: die Archivhalle mit versiegelten Glaskästen voller schwach glimmender Alltagsgegenstände (Echos); Nox geht von hinten gesehen zur Tresortür, Pip auf seiner Schulter.

line.text: Hier verwahrt das Archiv Echos. Dinge, die von Entscheidungen übrig bleiben.

kf.prompt: Wide shot of an endless underground archive hall with towering dark wooden shelves holding rows of sealed glass display cases; inside each case rests one ordinary old object — a key, a glove, a letter, a child's toy, a ring — glowing faintly gold or teal; brass ladders, warm hanging lanterns, light mist. The young man from the first reference image walks away from the camera down the hall toward a monumental round bronze vault door, seen from behind so his split navy and ochre coat is visible; the small brass compass creature from the second reference image sits on his shoulder.

shots.visual: Makro: ein versiegelter Glaskasten mit einem alten Messingschlüssel, der schwach glimmt (ein Echo).

line.text: Berührt Nox eines, sieht er den anderen Weg.

kf.prompt: Macro shot of one sealed glass display case on a dark wooden archive shelf; inside rests an old brass key that glows faintly gold from within, a red wax seal on the glass lid, warm lantern reflections on the glass, golden dust, shallow depth of field. Nothing else inside the case.

shots.visual: Halbnah: Nox zieht seinen Handschuh aus; Pip auf seiner Schulter, die Nadel zeigt zur Tür; Licht dringt durch die Fugen der geschlossenen Tür.

line.text: Jedes Mal kostet es ihn eine Erinnerung.

kf.prompt: Medium shot of the young man from the first reference image in the archive hall, pulling a dark leather glove off his right hand, determined and slightly sad, a small broken golden ring pin on his left collar, his split navy and ochre coat clearly visible; the brass compass creature from the second reference image sits on his shoulder, its red needle pointing toward warm golden light that leaks through the seams of a closed round vault door off-screen.

shots.visual: Zweier: Mira greift mit Handschuh nach Nox' Ärmel; eine Fotoecke ragt aus ihrer Manteltasche.

kf.prompt: Medium two-shot inside the underground archive hall, tall dark wooden shelves with sealed glass display cases and warm hanging lanterns behind them. On the left, the young woman from the second reference image, about 18 years old and almost as tall as him, grabs the navy blue right sleeve of the young man from the first reference image with her dark grey gloved hand; she looks at him worried and tired. On the right, he looks past her toward golden light leaking from the seams of a closed round vault door off-screen. His coat exactly like the reference: his right half navy blue, his left half ochre. A small corner of an old photograph, only its plain white back side visible, sticks out of the pocket of her coat. Both faces clearly visible.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young woman's mouth is slightly open as if speaking.

shots.fn: Nox' Ziel: er will wissen, warum es ruft
shots.visual: Close-up Nox, goldenes Licht von der Tür auf seinem Gesicht.

line.text: Es ruft mich. Ich muss wissen, warum.

kf.prompt: Close-up portrait of the young man from the reference image, warm golden light leaking through the seams of a closed vault door falls across his face, longing and determined expression, eyes glistening, a small broken golden ring pin clearly visible on his left collar, dark archive background with soft bokeh.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young man's mouth is slightly open as if speaking.
Same image, identical in every detail, but without the white lines under his eyes: natural clean skin, his eyes glistening with unshed tears.

shots.visual: Wie S01: die bloße Hand am Siegel.
Wie S02: achte Kerbe rot, Warnlicht.

shots.fn: Miras Können: sie versucht zu versiegeln
shots.visual: Mira presst beide Handschuh-Hände auf das Siegel, goldene Siegelzeichen flammen unter ihren Händen auf, rotes Warnlicht; das Siegel dreht sich trotzdem.

kf.prompt: Medium side shot: the young woman from the reference image presses both gloved hands flat against a large round bronze vault seal, glowing golden sealing glyphs flare under her palms, she strains with all her focus, red warning light washes over the scene, golden light leaks from the seams of the door.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young woman's face: a tense, strained expression, brows furrowed, lips pressed together, eyes focused hard on the seal, no smile.

shots.fn: Das eigene Echo ruft: die Tür öffnet sich
shots.visual: Die Tresortür springt auf, Licht flutet heraus.

kf.prompt: The monumental round bronze vault door in the archive hall swings wide open by itself, brilliant warm golden light floods out toward the camera, dust and light rays, a young man's silhouette in a long coat stands before it.

shots.visual: Vorraum: eine Taschenuhr schwebt im Lichtkegel; dahinter eine innere versiegelte Tür.

kf.prompt: A small dark stone vestibule: an antique gold pocket watch floats in mid-air inside a single beam of warm light, its chain drifting, golden dust in the beam; behind it in the darkness a second, smaller sealed round door is barely visible. Mysterious, quiet.

shots.visual: Close-up Nox, verwirrt.

kf.prompt: Close-up of the young man from the reference image looking up in confusion, lit from below by a warm golden glow, dark stone background, gentle bokeh, a small broken golden ring pin visible on his left collar.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young man's mouth is slightly open as if speaking.

shots.visual: Makro: Gravur N. VEYR · LINA auf dem Uhrdeckel; Miras Handschuh-Hand greift ins Bild.

kf.prompt: Extreme macro shot of the closed lid of an antique polished gold pocket watch filling the frame, smooth flat center area without any engraving, fine scratches, warm glints; a dark grey gloved hand reaches into the frame from the bottom left, dark background.

shots.visual: Nox' Fingerspitze berührt die Uhr. Weißblitz. Ton bricht ab.

kf.prompt: Extreme close-up: a young man's bare fingertip, with a deep navy coat sleeve, touching an antique gold pocket watch floating in a beam of light, a burst of golden light at the point of contact.

shots.visual: Blick aus der Tür eines einfahrenden Zuges: verschneiter Bahnsteig, Lina wartet mit Brief.

kf.prompt: View through the open door of an arriving train onto a snowy old railway platform at dusk, warm platform lamps, falling snow; the 11-year-old girl from the reference image in her cream wool coat and long red scarf stands on the platform holding a sealed letter, looking up at the camera with a hopeful smile. Soft dreamy overexposed glow at the edges.

shots.visual: Goldene Erinnerungspartikel lösen sich aus Nox und fliegen in die Uhr; sein Blick wird leer.

kf.prompt: Medium close-up of the young man from the reference image in a dark vestibule, glowing golden particles of light streaming out of his head and drifting toward a floating gold pocket watch in the upper corner, his face lit gold, sorrowful expression, a small broken golden ring pin visible on his left collar.
Same image, but the young man's eyes are now pale and empty, staring blankly, the expression gone still.

shots.visual: Close-up Mira, eine Träne.

kf.prompt: Close-up portrait of the young woman from the reference image, a single tear running down her cheek, eyes glossy, restrained grief, soft teal and gold light, dark background.

shots.fn: Twist — Mira bricht die Regel aus Gewissen
shots.visual: Mira hält ein altes Foto hoch: ein Junge und ein Mädchen mit rotem Schal.

line.text: Weil du sie … schon wieder vergessen hast.

kf.prompt: Medium shot of the young woman from the first reference image holding up an old faded photograph with her gloved hand toward the camera, tears on her face but a resolute look; the photograph shows a smiling black-haired boy in a navy sweater with an ochre scarf next to the girl from the second reference image in her red scarf holding a sealed letter, standing together in the snow.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young woman's mouth is slightly open as if speaking.

shots.visual: Mira dreht das Foto bewusst um: Rückseite in ihrem Handschuh, 'Lina lebt.' mit Nox' gebrochenem Ring signiert.

kf.prompt: Close-up of the blank back side of an old aged photograph made of cream paper, held by a dark grey gloved hand, completely empty paper with soft creases and a coffee-colored age stain at one corner, dark background, warm light.

shots.visual: Echo-Ringe, Titel DAS ECHO-ARCHIV · Folge 1, KI-Hinweis.

kf.prompt: Very dark, out-of-focus view of the endless underground archive hall with towering dark wooden shelves holding rows of sealed glass display cases; inside each case rests one ordinary old object — a key, a glove, a letter, a child's toy, a ring — glowing faintly gold or teal; brass ladders, warm hanging lanterns, light mist, the glowing objects only as faint soft bokeh, deep shadows, lots of empty dark space in the center.
